gen-dafont-groovy-gf-nokora: Groovy is funky and loose, its c nearly sealed shut. Nokora sits beneath in wide-open sans lowercase, a dark, steady stripe that gives those quirky headings firm ground to stand on.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Funky, loosely spaced and a bit cheeky, with a c that almost shuts. Noto Kufi Arabic is modern and open by comparison, and Groovy earns its place when the heading is big and brief.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans: Friendly from the first letter, Groovy has slim, pipe-cleaner joins and a c that barely opens, while Noto Sans fills its lines with tall lowercase. Expect a smooth, easy glide.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Friendly and a little funky, Groovy squeezes its c nearly shut. Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart and its lowercase tall and full, so the quirky heading gets a spacious, tidy partner underneath.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unj: Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined feels modern and businesslike, with generous gaps where curves meet stems. Groovy is the one for loose, playful display lettering, while the body font quietly handles the steady work of the text.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-anatolian: Loose, bouncy lettering with a c that nearly closes, set against a plain sans whose terminals point outward. Groovy plays, Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs keeps order.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Friendly and funky, Groovy draws flat, unmodulated lines that look best up large, while Noto Sans Arabic opens its small letters wide and stands tall on the x-height. One plays, one reads.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-armenian: A c squeezed almost shut makes Groovy instantly recognizable, its loosely tracked lowercase and constant-width arms adding to the fun. Noto Sans Armenian gives it wide, inviting rounds.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Noto Sans Avestan reads modern and clean, with a tall x-height and curve tips that never touch. Groovy, by contrast, is the playful one, its c nearly closed, and Noto Sans Avestan handles the quiet, open text.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Cheerful, funky, loosely spaced letters with a nearly closed c. Noto Sans Balinese follows in a plain sans with breathing room inside every curve, so the quirky headings and the short-ascender text sit comfortably together.
